context_requirements: Tonic or stress-induced glucocorticoid exposure to antagonize
Intact GR-dependent transcriptional program (e.g., NF-kB transrepression, AP-1 cross-talk)
Cell lines with low basal GR activity may show minimal response
falsifiers: No change in canonical GR target genes (TSC22D3, FKBP5, PER1, DUSP1) at 6 h or 24 h in any line
Strong and consistent upregulation of GR target genes across all lines, which would suggest agonist rather than antagonist activity
No effect on proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h despite GR expression
Lack of any transcriptional response in lines known to express functional GR (e.g., A549, HepG2, MCF7)

evidence.supports: GR antagonist RU-486 blocks glucocorticoid/GR-dependent apoptosis in thymocytes, demonstrating functional GR antagonism in immune cells
Selective GR antagonist CORT125281 inhibits GR transcriptional activity and alters metabolic/lipid gene programs in vivo
Nonsteroidal GR antagonist CP-472555 modulates CNS neuroendocrine transcriptional responses to hypoglycemia
GR antagonist RU 38486 can regulate CRH gene expression in neonatal rat hypothalamus, showing context-dependent GR-dependent transcription
First selective nonsteroidal GR antagonist binds GR and inhibits glucocorticoid-mediated transcriptional regulation
